'''Linapim''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. She worked in the [[Olaris Spaceport|Olaris spaceport's]] [[Olaris Mess Hall|mess hall]] in the bombed [[City/Legends|city]] [[Planet/Legends|world]], [[Taris/Legends|Taris]].

==Behind the scenes==
Linapim first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a social item vendor in the Olaris Mess Hall, Taris.
